about.title: Our story
about.lead: North Quay Leather is a made-up brand. This store is a working demo built by Lulu Studio: a real catalog, cart and Shopify checkout, with nothing actually for sale.
about.bags: The bags in the catalog are photographed samples, chosen for their shapes: structured totes, a barrel bag, a dome bag and small crossbodies in smooth, quilted, pebbled and embossed leather.
about.how: The site is built with Nuxt and uses Shopify as its back end. Products, prices, colours and the checkout come from a Shopify development store, and changes made in the Shopify admin appear here after the next build of the site.
about.photos: Product photos by Muneeb Malhotra on Pexels.
